craft_notes: Sthāyin: svādhyāya-vīra of study-and-making — hermetic couplets, hyphen-pressure; music in pack + terminal words; FIRST VERSE of the work sets the house voice (owner verdict required). Reflecting-gaining; unheld-to-end arc; stages gained end-weight. Rejected: (a) verbs for mirroring → killed: mirror kept as means. Read aloud: FROM-know-ing's-OWN-na-TURE … STA-ges HE-gains.

lines: From knowing's own nature, that god mirroring by himself —
Lord, from unheld to stages' end — stages he gains.
l4.sanskrit_cite: citsvābhāvyād asau devaḥ svātmanā vimṛṣan prabhuḥ | anāśritādibhūmyantā bhūmikāḥ pratipadyate
